method: Full-function disassembly of 0x40CE20-0x40D0E0 (mir3_full.asm), both call sites traced into their enclosing scene loops, element-getter/cache/projection/quad-render callees decoded, and the 0x100000 flag write site located in the actor packet parsers.

draw.order: color quad first (soft white backing), then element quad via 0x466CE0 case 2, then vtable+0x8C composite

callers.0x0041C76C: scene entity loop 0x41C5F0-0x41C7B9: iterates map grid (esi+0xF5326/0xF5328, cells +0xF5200, list +0xF532C), draws each entity shadow 0x40B180 then nameplate 0x40CE20
callers.0x0041CCAF: 0x41CBD0 (per-entity draw helper, also called at 0x41C77F) - same order: shadow then nameplate
callers.note: BOTH callers run for every scene entity (player, monster, NPC), so 0x40CE20 is the SHARED nameplate, not player-only - corrects the F287 label '0x40CE20 标签 = 仅玩家名牌'

errata.F287: 0x40CE20 is the shared scene-entity nameplate (both callers iterate all entities), not player-only; the player-only aspect is the 0x100000 flag which is server-driven per-entity

conclusions: 0x40CE20 draws a nameplate for every scene entity: element = [e+0x62A24] + (0x355 if state==0xF else 0x352) from library slot 0x51 (kind 0), via the 0x4542A0/0x454E50 element cache.

The quad is projected from world coords via camera [0x5667B8] + entity [e+0xE4]/[e+0xE8] - viewport halves [0x476474]/[0x476470], then drawn as a 50%-white alpha backing quad (0x3B808081) + element quad through 0x466CE0 case 2.
Both call sites (0x41C76C scene grid loop, 0x41CCAF per-entity helper) run for all entity kinds - the nameplate is shared across player/monster/NPC.
0x100000 is written by server attribute/state packet parsers (0x40D420/0x40D3B0/0x40D6C0) as part of the [e+0x61C68] descriptor dword (also mirrored to nameplate-visibility flag [e+0x61BD0]).
